svg.title: AutoDQA target architecture — sandbox as sole executor
svg.desc: A structural diagram of the AutoDQA target architecture. A user authenticates through a Cloudflare Access Zero Trust gate before reaching the AgentCore Runtime (LangGraph agent loop) at the center. Upward, the runtime routes model calls through Cloudflare AI Gateway to Amazon Bedrock. Downward, it routes execution requests through the AgentCore Gateway, which consults a dataset registry as policy, retrieves short-lived credentials from AWS Secrets Manager, and dispatches the job to a per-session Lambda MicroVM sandbox. The sandbox is the sole executor and reaches the read-only CDW and the documentation store itself using the injected credentials. Numbered arrows trace the agent loop.
